proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.cone
proposed_widenings.justification: Burning Hands creates a 15-foot cone AoE. The current Attachment area shape only supports sphere (radiusFeet). A cone variant is needed — e.g., { kind: 'cone'; lengthFeet: number } — to represent this and all other cone-shaped area spells (Thunderwave-style, Dragon's Breath, Cone of Cold, etc.).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin.on_self
proposed_widenings.justification: The cone emanates from the caster's position (range: Self). Neither existing AreaOrigin variant (point_within_range, on_primary_target) captures self-origin area effects. A cone shape may encode this implicitly, but if AreaOrigin remains, an on_self variant is needed for Burning Hands, Thunderwave, and similar self-emanating areas.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. [Range is Self; the caster is the cone's apex.] range.type = 'cone', indicating self-origin.

notes: The activation family and save_gate phase fit cleanly. Slot scaling is expressible as DiceAmount linear_per_level (axis=slot, base=3d6, perLevel={dice:1}, startingAtLevel=1). DamageType 'fire' exists. The only blockers are geometric: cone shape is absent from area Attachment, and self-origin is absent from AreaOrigin. The secondary flammable-objects effect is DM agenda (environmental narrative, not deterministic mechanical resolution) and is intentionally omitted. No new atoms are needed — this is purely a surface type gap.
